case_name: P.Abbulu vs M.Rama Mohana Veera Venkata ...
facts_of_case: Satyavathi is the absolute owner of properties; her husband Gani Raju died intestate leaving behind Satyavathi as his sole surviving legal heir; defendant was adopted by Satyavathi and Gani Raju but adoption is not legally valid; plaintiff seeks declaration of title to properties, recovery of possession, and return of moveables

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to establish a fact to prove it.

cited_cases: P.Abbulu vs M.Rama Mohana Veera Venkata ... (2020)

legal_principles.principle: A registered adoption deed is valid under law.
legal_principles.held: The points that emerge for determination in this appeal are: 1. Whether the adoption of the defendant taken by Satyavathi and Gani Raju under Ex.B-4 registered adoption deed is valid under law
cited_cases: P.Abbulu vs M.Rama Mohana Veera Venkata ... (2020)
